steps.label: trust step
argv:
[ -e /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.system.crt ] || { cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.system.crt.tmp && mv /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.system.crt.tmp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.system.crt; }
timeout 10 sh -c 'until [ -s /etc/cloudflare/certs/cloudflare-containers-ca.crt ]; do sleep 0.1; done' && cat /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.system.crt /etc/cloudflare/certs/cloudflare-containers-ca.crt >/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt.tmp && mv /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt.tmp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

steps.label: c dns example.com
argv: timeout 15 getent ahosts example.com; echo rc=$?

steps.label: c curl https example.com
argv: rm -f /tmp/body; curl -sS --max-time 20 -o /tmp/body -w 'http_code=%{http_code} remote_ip=%{remote_ip} ssl_verify=%{ssl_verify_result}\n'  'https://example.com/'; rc=$?; echo "curl_exit=$rc"; head -c 400 /tmp/body 2>/dev/null; exit $rc

steps.label: d loopback, own listener
argv: node -e "require('http').createServer((q,s)=>s.end('local ok')).listen(8080,'127.0.0.1')" >/dev/null 2>&1 & pid=$!; sleep 1; curl -sS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8080/; echo; kill $pid
